doc: The I20 adoption of the extracted rollup documents for derivation (holon.sorts.reextract): SORT-site laws are re-derived on the extracted facts (reextraction entries: python -m holon.statement_diff reextract --milestone M2 --append), and rule SORT-width derives its laws from the narrowing stores of these documents. width_corpus: the step refinement's evaluation of each width site on its corpus (holon fragments writes it beside results/M2/refinement/extracted.json; holon.sorts.width.decide reads it).
